import bpy,numpy as np,json
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Terminal_Craft'];out=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH':continue
 if any(k in o.name for k in ['corner','horizontal','band','shaped verge','beam','frame','pillar','post','bearer','platform edge','tower stone','wall panel']):
  if o.name.startswith('Terminal'):
   pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(p) for p in o.bound_box];p=np.array([p[:] for p in pts])
   out.append({'name':o.name,'mat':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m],'min':p.min(0).round(3).tolist(),'max':p.max(0).round(3).tolist(),'props':{k:str(v) for k,v in o.items() if k in ['crafted_role','harbor_rig']}})
